It reads your list of apps, which parts of the screen can scroll and where the items sit in the one it scrolls - to tell whether it moved, never what they show - the volume and whether the flashlight is on.
Acts on the command you spoke

Only that one: back, home, recent apps, quick settings, notifications, lock, screenshot, split screen, power menu; open an app or a settings page; scroll, page, swipe; media keys and volume; the flashlight; edit the field you started the command in, never a password field. It never taps buttons or confirms dialogs; a swipe does what your own swipe would do in that app.
Nothing is stored or sent - only your recording, and with cleanup its text, goes to the speech recognition you chose.
